mail.subject: Hinge sample B: torque results
mail.body:
Hi Rin,

The second batch of hinge samples is back from the lab. Average opening torque is 0.42 N·m against a target of 0.40 ± 0.05, so we are inside the window on all 12 pieces.

Two pieces show light scuffing on the cam after 5,000 cycles. Photos are attached. Do you want us to run the remaining 5,000 cycles before Friday's review, or stop here and section one?

Thanks,
Mateo
